topic: More people now work from home. Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?

turns.text: 我觉得在家办公的好处超过坏处，因为省了通勤时间。
我改主意了。对我来说，见不到同事这个坏处更重要。

seed.draft: Working from home saves me travel time, but I miss seeing my colleagues.

issue.title: 解释自己的判断
